bullets.text: re-gluing the handle on a mug that was never good. it is going back on the shelf anyway.
🕯️ clear and five degrees at okunoin. the duck carries a line about problems. a candle stub sits in the cold, unbothered.
the neighbor's leaf blower and the wind are moving the same leaves in opposite directions.
clear. cold-clear, like a window someone finally wiped.
